mapper.select: SELECT A.ATTEND_ID, A.EMPNO, E.ENAME, D.DNAME, TO_CHAR(A.WORK_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS WORK_DATE, TO_CHAR(A.CHECK_IN, 'HH24:MI') AS CHECK_IN, TO_CHAR(A.CHECK_OUT, 'HH24:MI') AS CHECK_OUT, A.WORK_MINUTES, A.STATUS, A.NOTE, TO_CHAR(A.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREATED_AT FROM ATTENDANCE A JOIN EMP E ON A.EMPNO = E.EMPNO JOIN DEPT D ON E.DEPTNO = D.DEPTNO WHERE A.EMPNO = #{empno} AND TRUNC(A.WORK_DATE) = TRUNC(SYSDATE)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ATTENDANCE (ATTEND_ID, EMPNO, WORK_DATE, CHECK_IN, STATUS, CREATED_AT) VALUES ( ATTENDANCE_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{empno}, TRUNC(SYSDATE), SYSDATE, CASE WHEN TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24')) * 60 + TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'MI')) > 9 * 60 THEN 'LATE' ELSE 'NORMAL' END, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE ATTENDANCE SET CHECK_OUT = SYSDATE, WORK_MINUTES = ROUND((SYSDATE - CHECK_IN) * 24 * 60), STATUS = CASE WHEN STATUS = 'LATE' THEN 'LATE' WHEN TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24')) * 60 + TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'MI')) < 18 * 60 THEN 'EARLY_LEAVE' ELSE 'NORMAL' END WHERE EMPNO = #{empno} AND TRUNC(WORK_DATE) = TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND CHECK_OUT IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT A.ATTEND_ID, A.EMPNO, E.ENAME, D.DNAME, TO_CHAR(A.WORK_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS WORK_DATE, TO_CHAR(A.CHECK_IN, 'HH24:MI') AS CHECK_IN, TO_CHAR(A.CHECK_OUT, 'HH24:MI') AS CHECK_OUT, A.WORK_MINUTES, A.STATUS, A.NOTE, TO_CHAR(A.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREATED_AT FROM ATTENDANCE A JOIN EMP E ON A.EMPNO = E.EMPNO JOIN DEPT D ON E.DEPTNO = D.DEPTNO WHERE A.EMPNO = #{empno} AND TO_CHAR(A.WORK_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') = #{month} ORDER BY A.WORK_DATE DESC

SELECT A.ATTEND_ID, A.EMPNO, E.ENAME, D.DNAME, TO_CHAR(A.WORK_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS WORK_DATE, TO_CHAR(A.CHECK_IN, 'HH24:MI') AS CHECK_IN, TO_CHAR(A.CHECK_OUT, 'HH24:MI') AS CHECK_OUT, A.WORK_MINUTES, A.STATUS, A.NOTE, TO_CHAR(A.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREATED_AT FROM ATTENDANCE A JOIN EMP E ON A.EMPNO = E.EMPNO JOIN DEPT D ON E.DEPTNO = D.DEPTNO WHERE TRUNC(A.WORK_DATE) = TRUNC(SYSDATE) ORDER BY A.CHECK_IN DESC

SELECT NULL AS ATTEND_ID, E.EMPNO, E.ENAME, D.DNAME, NULL AS WORK_DATE, NULL AS CHECK_IN, NULL AS CHECK_OUT, NULL AS WORK_MINUTES, 'ABSENT' AS STATUS, NULL AS NOTE, NULL AS CREATED_AT FROM EMP E JOIN DEPT D ON E.DEPTNO = D.DEPTNO WHERE E.EMPNO NOT IN ( SELECT EMPNO FROM ATTENDANCE WHERE TRUNC(WORK_DATE) = TRUNC(SYSDATE) ) ORDER BY E.ENAME
